content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

Your current digital commerce setup is likely built on the infrastructure of Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. However, each of these platforms has its own set of limitations and restrictions. Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving many countries without access to its services. PayPal, on the other hand, can suspend your account at any time, holding your funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad provides a basic solution for selling digital products but lacks the scalability and flexibility of a custom-built sovereign digital commerce stack. A sovereign digital commerce stack, on the other hand, gives you the power to build and deploy your own infrastructure, free from the restrictions and limitations of third-party platforms. By using open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, you can create a custom-built infrastructure that meets your specific needs and requirements.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Restricted countries are a major concern for digital creators who rely on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. These platforms often have limited or no presence in these countries, making it difficult for creators to sell their digital products. A sovereign digital commerce stack, however, provides a permanent structural alternative to these platforms. By building your own infrastructure, you can bypass the limitations of Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad and start selling your digital products in any country, regardless of their presence or absence on these platforms. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products without worrying about the restrictions and limitations of third-party platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical considerations for digital creators who want to sell their products quickly and efficiently. Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad all charge varying fees for their services, ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 5% + $0.30 per transaction. A sovereign digital commerce stack, on the other hand, provides a low-cost alternative to these platforms. By using NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with fees as low as 0.5%. This means that you can keep more of your hard-earned money and focus on growing your business.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential considerations for digital creators who want to maintain control over their products and customers. A sovereign digital commerce stack provides a permanent structural alternative to third-party platforms, giving you full ownership and control over your products and customers. With automation features like NOWPayments' automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, you can streamline your payment process and focus on what matters most - creating and selling your digital products. Additionally, with delivery options like Google Drive and Cloudflare R2, you can ensure that your customers receive their products quickly and efficiently.
